lead: Jewellery worn on the body, organised by where it is worn (rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, brooches, head, body, piercings), then by regional tradition and hip-hop forms; each kind runs from named icons and archetypes to versions, with makers in the brand register, techniques in the traditions register and period (Georgian to Retro) as a view.

b.m: How well the stone is cut
b.w: Cut is weighed first of the four stone grades (the 4Cs); applies to every stone-set piece.
Second of the 4Cs; graded on the GIA colour scale, D to Z.

b.v: FL > IF > VVS > VS > SI > I

b.w: Last of the 4Cs; a higher carat is not automatically better.
Buyers trust a grading certificate and weigh which lab issued it; natural versus lab-grown must be disclosed.
Purity (fineness) is the hallmarked measure of the metal.
Solid precious metal outranks a plated base metal.

b.m: Period, materials and rarity (vintage and antique pieces)
b.v: Georgian · Victorian · Edwardian · Art Nouveau · Art Deco · Retro · Mid-century · Modern
b.w: Period is an attribute and a browse view, not a kind; weighed after the maker's mark.
No shop ladder fetched; kept from the earlier notes.

depts.note: Engagement rings by setting, everyday and designer bands by archetype; stone shape is a type, not a kind.

b.w: Prongs and bezels hold the stone; worker to source a jeweller/GIA guide.

s.brief: Organise by setting. Archetypes: Tiffany Setting (six-prong solitaire, Tiffany & Co.), Cartier 1895, De Beers/Harry Winston classics where sourced; toi et moi (Napoleon/Josephine history); three-stone (past-present-future). Stone shapes (round brilliant, princess, cushion, oval, emerald, pear, marquise, radiant, Asscher, heart) go in 't' on each kind, not separate kinds. Pavé and bezel are setting types in 't'. Add GIA or similar as sources for shape/setting vocabulary.

k.brief: Tiffany Setting as first archetype; prong/bezel/tension in t.
Centre stone ringed by smaller stones.
Trilogy ring.
Two stones side by side or bypass.
Many small stones grouped to read as one; Princess Diana/Kate sapphire cluster if sourced.
Full or half circle of matched stones; also sold as anniversary band.

s.brief: Band ring absorbs Wedding band (k6) — wedding/anniversary becomes a type. Designer icon archetypes: Cartier Love ring, Cartier Trinity (1924), Cartier Juste un Clou ring, Bulgari B.zero1, Boucheron Quatre, Tiffany T ring; Pomellato Nudo under Cocktail ring. Signet ring: trim the 8 small-maker SKUs to archetypes (oval, cushion, chevalier/pinky, seal-engraved) plus 2-3 makers. Thumb ring: cut Chapman's 7 SKUs to at most 1-2. Order by significance, not alphabet.

k.brief: Types: wedding band, comfort fit, court, D-shape, flat, men's band. Archetypes Love, Trinity, B.zero1, Quatre, Tiffany T.
Large statement stone ring; Pomellato Nudo; 1920s-50s cocktail history.
Gimmel/puzzle ring of interlocking hoops.

b.w: Secure backs (screw, push, butterfly) decide whether studs get lost.

s.brief: Add archetypes: diamond stud, pearl stud, Van Cleef & Arpels Alhambra earrings, Tiffany Elsa Peretti Bean/Teardrop, Cartier Juste un Clou earring, Chanel CC studs where sourced; creole and Bali hoops (old 'Bali' model) under Hoop earring. Jhumka moves to South Asian shelf. Add Ear jacket and Clip-on earring as new kinds.

k.brief: Creole, Bali, sleeper in t or archetypes.
Front stud with a second ornament behind the lobe.
Unpierced clip or screw-back earring; vintage costume makers.

depts.note: Chain link patterns are archetypes of Necklace chain; Cuban and rope chains sit on the Hip-hop shelf.

b.w: Hollow links dent and break; worker to source.

s.brief: Necklace chain: archetypes by link pattern ordered by significance — cable/trace, curb, figaro, box, snake, herringbone, Singapore, wheat/spiga, anchor/mariner, franco, byzantine, ball, paperclip; Hermès Chaîne d'ancre as a named version of anchor. Pearl necklace: strand lengths (collar, choker, princess, matinée, opera, rope) in t; Mikimoto as originator archetype; Akoya/South Sea/Tahitian/freshwater in t. Tennis necklace includes the hip-hop 'tennis chain' as an archetype. Neck ring/torc: Celtic torc history. Mangalsutra moves to South Asian shelf.

k.brief: Chain with stones or beads set at intervals; Tiffany Diamonds by the Yard (Elsa Peretti).

s.brief: Pendant archetypes: Van Cleef & Arpels Alhambra (1968), Chopard Happy Diamonds (1976), Tiffany Elsa Peretti Open Heart and Bean, Return to Tiffany heart tag, Bulgari Serpenti/Diva's Dream, Cartier Love pendant (old model). Charm: replace the 12 Pandora SKUs with charm-system archetypes — Pandora Moments (keep as range), Italian/modular link charm (Nomination), Thomas Sabo, Links of London, Victorian/Mid-century charms; Pandora gets a brand-register entry. Locket: Victorian and mourning lockets as archetypes. Cameo: shell/hardstone cameo traditions (Torre del Greco) to the traditions register.

k.brief: Carved relief in shell or stone; worn as pendant or brooch.
Letter or name pendant/nameplate (Carrie nameplate) — keep apart from hip-hop iced pendant.

s.brief: Icon archetypes: Cartier Love bracelet (Aldo Cipullo, 1969, screwdriver), Cartier Juste un Clou (1971), Tiffany T and HardWear, Elsa Peretti Bone cuff, David Yurman Cable (old model), Bulgari Serpenti, Hermès Chaîne d'ancre and Clic H, Van Cleef Alhambra bracelet; Navajo silver cuff as an archetype linked to tradition. Charm bracelet: Pandora Moments (keep), Italian charm bracelet. Bangle keeps choor/kada/kankan as types. Tennis bracelet: Chris Evert 1987 naming story.

k.brief: ID bracelet with engraved plate.
Knotted or woven cord bracelet.
Bajuband as type.

depts.note: Vintage costume makers (Miriam Haskell, Trifari, Schiaparelli, Coro, Eisenberg) belong in the brand register and are archetype makers here.

s.brief: Brooch archetypes: Cartier Panthère (Jeanne Toussaint), Trifari crown pin and jelly belly, Miriam Haskell, Schiaparelli, Victorian mourning brooch, bar brooch, sweetheart brooch, Art Deco clip; period as view. Cufflinks: knot (silk), chain-link, T-bar, Cartier Santos/Tiffany where sourced; trim Oliver Brown to one. Patches move out to craft.

depts.note: Plain and everyday hair clips are in Personal Care & Beauty.

s.brief: Tiara archetypes: kokoshnik, fringe tiara, bandeau; royal and Cartier/Chaumet tiaras where sourced; Jennifer Behr models kept as fashion versions. Hairpin: kanzashi types (kogai, bira-bira, tsumami) to t and Japanese tradition register. Maang tikka moves to South Asian shelf. Jewelled clips from old k46 go to H1.
Payal (South Asian anklet) and ghungroo bells as types of anklet; add Body chain (harness worn over torso).

k.brief: Bichiya as type.
Kamarbandh is on the South Asian shelf.
Chain harness worn over chest and back.

depts.note: Quality is material and finish: implant-grade titanium (ASTM F136), implant-grade steel (F138), niobium, solid 14-18K gold; threadless and internally threaded ends.

b.v: ASTM F136 titanium / F138 steel / solid gold > surgical steel > plated
b.w: Association of Professional Piercers (APP) standards; worker to source.

b.v: threadless or internally threaded > externally threaded
b.w: APP; external threads scrape the piercing.

s.brief: Add the high-end maker layer to the brand register and as archetype makers: Anatometal, BVLA (Body Vision Los Angeles), Industrial Strength, Neometal (threadless originator), Junipurr, Maria Tash, Buddha Jewelry Organics. Threadless end is a new kind (the decorative top). Seamless ring new. Gauge and diameter as detail axes. Navel curve keeps dangle types.

k.brief: Push-pin decorative top; Neometal originator.
Ring with butted ends and no bead.

s.brief: Organic and stone plugs (Maya, Gorilla Glass, Diablo Organics where sourced); material as t (glass, stone, wood, titanium, silicone). Ear weight keeps Maedusa Helios as version.

depts.note: Iced-out pieces and heavy chains as a scene; tennis chains are on the Tennis necklace kind.

b.m: Solid gold and real stones versus plated and simulated
b.v: solid gold + natural diamond > solid gold + moissanite/lab > vermeil > plated + CZ

s.brief: Archetypes: Miami Cuban link (widths, box clasp), rope/dookie chain (Run-DMC era), Jesus piece, iced chain pendants (custom logo pieces), nameplate and doorknocker-scale pieces; makers Jacob & Co., Johnny Dang, Ben Baller, Avianne, Elliot Eliantte where sourced; grillz (Johnny Dang, Paul Wall era; open-face, full set). Keep register-level brands only.

k.brief: Jesus piece, custom logo pendants.
Removable decorative tooth cover.

depts.note: Forms belonging to one tradition; techniques (kundan, polki, jadau, meenakari, temple, Zuni inlay, filigree) live in the traditions register.

b.w: Hallmarking (BIS) for Indian gold; Indian Arts and Crafts Act for Native American work; worker to source.

s.brief: Traditions register entries: kundan, polki, jadau, meenakari, temple jewellery (Nagercoil), Thewa, filigree (Cuttack tarakasi). Kinds take forms; old Tanmaniya stays as a mangalsutra archetype. Keep definitions plain.

k.brief: Crescent-moon earring.
Large bridal nose ring, often chained to the hair.
Forehead chain ornament along the hairline.
Bridal waist belt ornament.
Long layered bridal necklace.

s.brief: Traditions register: Navajo silverwork, Zuni inlay/petit point/needlepoint, Hopi overlay, Amazigh (Berber) silver, Tuareg silver, Ethiopian Orthodox crosses, Māori pounamu, Irish Claddagh (Galway). Archetypes inside kinds: naja, Agadez cross (and other Tuareg crosses), Lalibela/Axum crosses.

k.brief: Navajo/Zuni silver necklace with blossom beads and naja.
Agadez and other regional crosses.
Worn neck cross (meskel); processional crosses are F4.
Tizerzai/tabzimt silver brooch-pins and pendants.
Māori pounamu neck pendant; also koru/hei matau as archetypes.
Hands-heart-crown ring from Galway.
